name: Blade Adept
summary: A small number of arcanists learn to use blades as part of their spellcasting and in combat.

features.name: Sword Bond (Su)
features.summary: At 1st level, a blade adept develops a bond with a one-handed piercing or slashing melee weapon and gains proficiency with it if it is simple or martial. The selected blade is also the archetype's bonded object.

features.name: Sentient Sword (Su)

progressionProfiles.label: Black blade progression

values.special: Alertness, black blade strike, telepathy, unbreakable

progressionProfiles.summary: The bonded sword uses Arcanist class level for this table, or Arcanist caster level after selecting Eldritch Blade. Its arcane pool equals 1 plus its Intelligence modifier.

features.summary: At 3rd level, the blade adept’s bonded sword becomes a powerful, sentient black blade . The blade advances as a black blade using the blade adept’s class level in place of the magus’s class level and points from her arcane reservoir in place of the magus’s arcane pool. A blade adept with this class feature cannot have a familiar of any kind, even from another class. This ability replaces the arcanist exploit gained at 3rd level.

features.name: Black Blade Strike (Sp)

resourceActions.label: Use Black Blade Strike

activeEffect.name: Black Blade Strike
activeEffect.description: Add the displayed bonus to damage rolls made with the bonded black blade.

resourceActions.summary: As a free action, spend 1 black blade pool point to increase the bonded blade's damage for 1 minute.

features.summary: As a free action, spend 1 point from the black blade's arcane pool to grant it a +1 bonus on damage rolls for 1 minute. The bonus increases by +1 for every 4 levels beyond 1st.

features.name: Energy Attunement (Su)

resourceActions.label: Attune Elemental Damage

modes.label: Cold
modes.summary: The bonded blade deals cold damage instead of its normal weapon damage.

modes.label: Electricity
modes.summary: The bonded blade deals electricity damage instead of its normal weapon damage.

modes.label: Fire
modes.summary: The bonded blade deals fire damage instead of its normal weapon damage.

activeEffect.name: Energy Attunement
activeEffect.description: The bonded blade's weapon damage uses the selected energy type until the start of your next turn.

resourceActions.summary: As a free action, spend 1 black blade pool point to change its weapon damage to cold, electricity, or fire until your next turn.

resourceActions.label: Attune Sonic or Force Damage

modes.label: Sonic
modes.summary: The bonded blade deals sonic damage instead of its normal weapon damage.

modes.label: Force
modes.summary: The bonded blade deals force damage instead of its normal weapon damage.

activeEffect.name: Advanced Energy Attunement
activeEffect.description: The bonded blade's weapon damage uses the selected energy type until the start of your next turn.

resourceActions.summary: As a free action, spend 2 black blade pool points to change its weapon damage to sonic or force until your next turn.

features.summary: Spend 1 black blade pool point to replace the blade's damage with cold, electricity, or fire, or 2 points for sonic or force, until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Teleport Blade (Sp)

resourceActions.label: Teleport Blade using Reservoir

activeEffect.name: Teleport Blade
activeEffect.description: The black blade teleports from up to 1 mile away into your hand.

resourceActions.summary: As a standard action, spend 1 reservoir point to call the black blade from up to 1 mile away.

resourceActions.label: Teleport Blade using Blade Pool

activeEffect.name: Teleport Blade
activeEffect.description: The black blade teleports from up to 1 mile away into your hand.

resourceActions.summary: As a standard action, spend 1 black blade pool point to call it from up to 1 mile away.

features.summary: As a standard action, spend 1 point from either the arcanist's reservoir or the black blade's pool to call the blade instantaneously from up to 1 mile away.

features.name: Transfer Arcana (Su)

resourceActions.label: Transfer 2 Blade Points

actorSavingThrow.failureDescription: The failed attempt leaves you fatigued.
actorSavingThrow.repeatedFailureDescription: A further failed attempt while fatigued leaves you exhausted.

resourceActions.summary: After succeeding at the displayed Will save, expend 2 blade points to recover 1 reservoir point. The once-per-day use is consumed.

resourceActions.label: Transfer 4 Blade Points

actorSavingThrow.failureDescription: The failed attempt leaves you fatigued.
actorSavingThrow.repeatedFailureDescription: A further failed attempt while fatigued leaves you exhausted.

resourceActions.summary: After succeeding at the displayed Will save, expend 4 blade points to recover 2 reservoir points. The once-per-day use is consumed.

features.summary: Once per day as a full-round action, attempt a Will save against the blade's Ego. On success, recover 1 reservoir point per 2 blade pool points spent; failure causes fatigue, or exhaustion if already fatigued.

features.name: Spell Defense (Sp)

resourceActions.label: Use Spell Defense

activeEffect.name: Black Blade Spell Defense
activeEffect.description: Your spell resistance equals the black blade's Ego until the start of your next turn.

resourceActions.summary: As a free action, spend 1 black blade pool point to gain spell resistance equal to the blade's Ego until your next turn.

features.summary: Spend 1 point from the black blade's pool as a free action to gain spell resistance equal to its Ego until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Life Drinker (Su)

resourceActions.label: Restore 2 Blade Points
resourceActions.summary: After the black blade kills an eligible living creature, restore 2 points to its pool.

resourceActions.label: Restore Both Pools
resourceActions.summary: After an eligible kill, restore 1 point to the blade pool and 1 point to the reservoir.

resourceActions.label: Gain Life Drinker Temporary HP
resourceActions.summary: After an eligible kill, gain temporary hit points equal to the black blade's Ego for up to 1 minute.

features.summary: When the black blade kills a living creature with Hit Dice at least half your character level, restore blade pool points, split recovery between pools, or gain temporary hit points equal to the blade's Ego for 1 minute.

features.name: Adept Exploits
features.summary: A blade adept can select from the following additional exploits. Eldritch Blade : A blade adept with this exploit uses her caster level instead of her class level for the purpose of advancing her bonded sword’s powers. Magus Arcana : A blade adept can select any of the following magus arcana , using her arcane reservoir in place of the magus’s arcane pool: arcane accuracy, close range, critical strike, dispelling strike, and hasted assault. The blade adept treats her arcanist level as her magus level when determining the effects of magus arcana and when specific arcana are available. A blade adept can take this exploit multiple times. Each time it is taken, it applies to a different magus arcana. Spell Strike (Su) : The blade adept can deliver touch spells with her bonded weapon. This works as the magus ability of the same name. Student of the Blade (Ex) : A blade adept can choose from any of the following bonus feats: Arcane Strike , Weapon Finesse , and Weapon Focus (in the weapon she is bonded to) . This exploit can be taken multiple times. Each time it is taken, it applies to a different feat. Weapon Specialization (Ex) : The arcanist gains Weapon Specialization with her chosen weapon as a bonus feat. The blade adept does not need to meet the prerequisites for this feat, but must have the Weapon Focus feat with her chosen weapon to select this exploit. The arcanist must be at least 5th level to select this exploit.
